# cpanel_filesystem_text_file (Data Source)

Reads one UTF-8 text file below `public_html` in a cPanel account. Files larger than 1 MiB are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_filesystem_text_file" "robots" {
  path = "public_html/robots.txt"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The normalized file path below `public_html`, relative to the cPanel account home.

### Read-Only

- `absolute_path` (String) The absolute file path reported by cPanel.
- `content` (String, Sensitive) The exact UTF-8 file content.
- `content_sha256` (String) The lowercase SHA-256 digest of the exact file content.
- `permissions` (String) The four-digit octal file permissions reported by cPanel.
- `size_bytes` (Number) The exact UTF-8 content size in bytes.
